> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **4** cross-cutting symbol(s) contributed no route anchor: `enforceAuth (23 routes)`, `resolveExecCtx (28 routes)`, `routeManager (20 routes)`, `resolveProtocol (25 routes)`
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **18** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7277c07f6883fbb5e8893cbe5ad91dd482f83723` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `fba8edf3a7ab684d4d3cf3ca7be9355122d56fd5` — the merge of head `06bd4fcbc9c8c9fd0c4d5c7377f570644a8fad1f` into base `7277c07f6883fbb5e8893cbe5ad91dd482f83723`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin fba8edf3a7ab684d4d3cf3ca7be9355122d56fd5 && git checkout fba8edf3a7ab684d4d3cf3ca7be9355122d56fd5
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 7277c07f6883fbb5e8893cbe5ad91dd482f83723 06bd4fcbc9c8c9fd0c4d5c7377f570644a8fad1f && git checkout -B drift-repro 7277c07f6883fbb5e8893cbe5ad91dd482f83723 && git merge --no-ff 06bd4fcbc9c8c9fd0c4d5c7377f570644a8fad1f

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7277c07f6883fbb5e8893cbe5ad91dd482f83723
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 7277c07f6883fbb5e8893cbe5ad91dd482f83723` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `06bd4fcbc9c8c9fd0c4d5c7377f570644a8fad1f`
Local-runs: none

**Face:** the declaration face. This is a move-only slice of `@objectstack/rest`, and no token of the moved body changed. The diff does four things:
- it moves one registrar body into one new module, `packages/rest/src/search-routes.ts`;
- it grows the registrar list 9 → 10 and re-points the nine readers of that list;
- it re-points one gate's target table, `scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs`;
- it adds the stub, one import and their comments to `rest-server.ts`.

No `export` is added anywhere. The 13-file list holds no published schema and no governed path. `record-recognisers --template --paths` over that list derives `TIER_DEFAULT`. `Governed Surface Queue Guard` concluded success. The PR body reads `Clause-②: no` with no arm, and the diff adds no changeset.

**Inputs:**
- card #23050: its body and all 38 comments. These include the triage `6126748916`, slice 1's landing `6136102437`, slice 2's refinement `6189011700`, the seat ruling on the `static` receiver `6205442867`, the seat ruling on providers in `6215084478`, the slice 9 claim `6215613624` and the slice 9 report `6217434161`;
- slice 8's record `6214674841` on PR #23882, used as precedent;
- PR #23959:
  - its body;
  - its file list: 13 files, +260 / −90, which matches `git diff --numstat` file for file;
  - its one comment, the advisory Docs Drift Check;
  - its timeline: the labels, and the declaration `6217491481` on #6017;
- the net diff against the merge base `b9dbc3d895`;
- the 44 check-runs on this head, read last.

**Method:** read-only. Every count below was read off the git objects of the merge base and the head with `git show`, text `diff`, `grep` and one text-only count script. The script applies each reader's own rule to that text: the execctx site and forwarder rules, the docblock opener rule, `querySlots`, the dogfood population and forwarder-slice rule, the two realtime tripwire regexes, and `scanSource`'s two dialect rules. No repository code was built, tested or re-run. The merge base's `rest-server.ts` blob (`2ba4159180`) is the same blob as at the dev's base `d5666be876`. Between those two commits, nothing changed under `packages/rest`, `packages/qa`, `docs/qa` or `packages/spec/liveness`, or in the gate. So the PR's base line numbers apply as written. The merge commit `06bd4fcbc9` changes none of the 13 files.

### ① Derived judgments

No accept set changes and no public surface changes. Each change the diff makes is judged below.

1. **The moved body is byte-identical once de-indented: right.**
   - Base `rest-server.ts` `:8998`–`:9062` is 65 lines. With one 4-space indent removed, it equals head `search-routes.ts` `:74`–`:138`, and `diff` finds 0 differing lines.
   - Every line in the range starts with 4 spaces. The range has no empty line and no trailing whitespace.
   - Its one template literal, `${basePath}/search` (base `:9001`), sits on one line. Every other backtick in the range is in a line comment. So removing the indent changed no runtime string.
   - The body has no `RestServer.` access. The `static` exception was not used, and no token changed.
   - The rest of `rest-server.ts` changes in two hunks, +13 / −65 in total:
     - the import and its comment (head `:344`–`:345`);
     - the stub, 11 lines in place of the 65 (head `:9000`–`:9010`).
   - The file goes from 10,047 to 9,995 lines.
   - The private method keeps its name, its JSDoc (base `:8993`, head `:8995`) and its position.
   - The call site in `registerForBase` is unchanged: base `:4806`, head `:4808`.
     - It is still guarded by `api.enableSearch`.
     - It still sits between `registerUiEndpoints` and `registerEmailEndpoints`.
     - `registerRoutes` is otherwise identical (base `:4790`–`:4870` against head `:4792`–`:4872`, `diff` empty). So the registration order holds on every base.

2. **The host lists exactly what the body reads: right.**
   - The body's code reads of `this.` (comments excluded), one each:
     - `routeManager` (module `:75`);
     - `resolveProtocol` (`:81`);
     - `resolveExecCtx` (`:82`);
     - `enforceAuth` (`:83`).
   - No comment in the body mentions `this.`.
   - `SearchRouteHost` (`:60`–`:65`) declares exactly these 4. Each is typed by indexed access on the class.
   - The body has no bare `this`, no element access on `this` and no `function` keyword. The two text hits for "function" and "this" are inside string literals (`:85`, `:86`).
   - Every free identifier in the body is a global (`String`, `Array`, `Boolean`) or one of seven imports:
     - `GLOBAL_SEARCH_PARAMS`, `UNDECLARED_WHOLE_NUMBER_PARAM` and `readDeclaredQueryNumber` from `./rest-server.js`;
     - `refuseUnknownQueryParams`, `refuseRepeatedQueryParams`, `mapDataError` and `logUnexpectedRouteError` from the modules `rest-server.ts` imports them from.
   - So the seat's count of four members, one read each, holds.

3. **Value or closure, member by member: right.**
   - **`routeManager` goes by value.**
     - Its one read is the top-level `register` call, which runs during registration.
     - The class reassigns the field only at head `:5179` / `:5183`, in the try/finally around `registerMetadataEndpointsInner`.
     - `registerForBase` calls the search registrar after `registerMetadataEndpoints` has returned, so outside that window.
   - **The three methods go as late-bound closures.** So their receiver is still the server, and a spy set on the server after registration is still the one reached.
   - **No getter is owed.** The body reads no field at request time. The protocol is resolved per request by `resolveProtocol`, a method.
   - **No provider is read,** so the seat's provider ruling (`6215084478`) does not apply.
   - `searchAll.call(p, …)` keeps the protocol as its receiver, as before.
   - The dev's late-binding measurement and its closure ablation are the dev's, not re-run here. They match this reading.

4. **No helper gained an export, and nothing reaches the published `.d.ts`: right.**
   - The diff adds or removes no `export` line in `rest-server.ts`.
   - The three helpers were already exported at base: `GLOBAL_SEARCH_PARAMS` (base `:661`), `UNDECLARED_WHOLE_NUMBER_PARAM` (`:767`) and `readDeclaredQueryNumber` (`:832`). There is one declaration of each. Nothing is copied.
   - **Why the `.d.ts` does not change:**
     - `@objectstack/rest` publishes `dist`, `README.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` only.
     - Its build runs the root `tsup.config.ts`, which builds from the single entry `src/index.ts` with `splitting: false`.
     - `src/index.ts` is untouched. It re-exports from `./rest-server.js` by name only: `RestServer`, the types `RestProtocol` and `MountedRoute`, and `metaItemPackageBinding`. It has no `export *`.
     - It names neither the new module nor the three helpers.
     - `SearchRouteHost` appears only inside a private method body, which declaration emit does not reach.
   - The new import cycle is harmless.
     - The module's top level declares one interface and one function, and reads no import.
     - The three helpers are read only at request time.
     - Earlier modules already import values from `rest-server.ts`: `data-action-routes.ts` (`readDeclaredQueryNumber` among them), `batch-routes.ts`, `discovery-routes.ts` and `email-routes.ts`.
   - The dev's `.d.ts` sha and export-list readings are the dev's, not re-run here. They are what this construction predicts.

5. **The registrar list and every reader were re-counted, and no reader was loosened: right.**
   - The list grows 9 → 10 by one appended entry. Exactly nine files import it, and all nine are in the diff. Each moves its length pin 9 → 10.
   - **execctx census.** Its site rule counts lines that hold `this.resolveExecCtx(environmentId, req)`.
     - Sites: 62 at both. Base 24 + 9 + 5 + 7 + 8 + 1 + 5 + 2 + 1; head 23 + 9 + 5 + 7 + 8 + 1 + 5 + 2 + 1 + 1.
     - Split: 46 bare / 16 caught at both. The search site is bare, and the `enforceAuth` guard is its next line (`:83`).
     - Mentions of `resolveExecCtx`: 117 → 121. `rest-server.ts` goes 58 → 59 (one site out, one forwarder's 2 mentions in). The module holds 3 (the site 1, the interface member 2).
     - Forwarder lines in `rest-server.ts`: 10 → 11. The pin is exact: (10 − 1) + 3 − 1 = 11.
     - Neither map gains an entry. That is right, because the module carries one registrar and that registrar reads the seam.
   - **ui-view pair** (counted over the list):
     - `this.enforceAuth(` 57 → 58 and `this.resolveExecCtx(` 72 → 73.
     - `rest-server.ts` stays at 19 and 34 (one site out, one forwarder in).
     - `this.enforceEnvironmentOwnership(` stays 1. The floors of 40 are unchanged.
   - **dogfood blind-spot row:**
     - `this.routeManager.register(` stays at 63 = 21 + 9 + 5 + 7 + 8 + 1 + 6 + 4 + 1 + 1.
     - `private register*Endpoints(` 16, `registerPerItemRoute(` 8, `const registerPerItemRoute =` 1 and the forwarder slice 1 are each unchanged.
     - The population 70 / 19 / 51 is unchanged. The search door is outside `registerMetadataEndpoints` before and after.
     - **`enforceAuth` goes 100 → 104**: `rest-server.ts` 42 → 43, and the module 3.
       - The four new mentions are the seam once: the forwarder 2, the interface member 2.
       - The one call site moved and is counted in both readings. No call site was added.
       - It is an exact re-anchor, as in slices 3–8.
     - The new control `search-routes.ts: this.routeManager.register(` reads 1. `registrar list length` reads 10.
     - `populationRule` now names the new module and the moved registrar.
   - **docblock pin:**
     - The module has exactly 3 TSDoc openers (`:3`, `:53`, `:67`), none stacked, and its floor is 3.
     - The moved range held 0, so `rest-server.ts` keeps 164 at base and head (floor 100).
     - The floors' sum goes 37 → 40, and the sum is pinned exactly.
   - **query-number 9, canonical-query 4, meta-draft 8:**
     - The module has 0 `Number` / `parseInt` / `parseFloat` tokens and no unary plus. The body reads its two caps through `readDeclaredQueryNumber`, whose one coercion stays in `rest-server.ts`.
     - It has 0 `query:` slot lines (by `querySlots`' own regex) and 0 draft tokens.
     - Each new floor is 0, and each sum is unchanged. The canonical census builds its rows from the list, so the new floor entry is its only owed edit.
   - **dogfood realtime tripwires:** both probe regexes read 0 on each of the ten files.

6. **`scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs` is re-pointed, not loosened: right.**
   - The gate's diff is +29 / −0: one new `MODULES` entry and two history comments on the `rest-server.ts` row. No number, rule or other entry changes.
   - Counted on the module by `scanSource`'s own rules, over its three `.json(` calls:
     - `:86`, the 501 body `{ code, message }`: no `error` key, so neither `stringError` nor `siblingCode`;
     - `:127` and `:131` pass a variable, not an object literal.
     - So `stringError` is 0 and `siblingCode` is 0, as declared.
   - The body moved byte for byte, and the stub has no `.json(` call. So `rest-server.ts` keeps its pinned 16 and 14.
   - Both sums hold:
     - `stringError`: 16 + 13 + 8 + 1 + 0 + 0 + 0 + 0 + 1 + 0 = 39;
     - `siblingCode`: 14 + 15 + 8 + 9 + 4 + 1 + 0 + 0 + 3 + 0 = 54.
   - `auditDialectOnly` requires each count to equal its pin and reds in both directions. So the pins are as tight as before.
   - The new entry is `dialectOnly` with ratchet `#9559`, like the eight moved modules before it.
   - A `MODULES` declaration also takes the file out of the express-writer walk (`discoverExpressRoutes`). So no `EXPRESS_RESPONSE_MODULES` entry is owed.
   - `Lint · docs & code guards` and `Lint & Repo Gates` concluded success.

7. **The readers left untouched read no moved line: right.**
   - **Line citations:** none of the tree's `rest-server.ts:NNNN` citations falls in the moved range `:8993`–`:9063`. Outside released CHANGELOG text, the highest is `:5872`.
   - **ADR anchors:** the moved body cites no `ADR-NNNN`, so no anchor is owed. The `rest-server.ts` anchor names nothing about search.
   - **`packages/spec`:**
     - `liveness/rest_api.json` cites `rest-server.ts#registerRoutes` for the `if (this.config.api.enableSearch)` gate. That line did not move (head `:4807`).
     - No liveness evidence string quotes a moved line.
     - `rest-server.zod.ts` `:154` and `core-services.zod.ts` `:153` name the method without a file. The method still registers the door, so both stay true.
   - **The platform checklist** reaches the search door through `rest-route-ledger.ts`, by route (`search.json` `:571`, `:769`). No checklist anchor names the registrar or the file.
   - **Other source readers of `rest-server.ts` read tokens the move does not carry:**
     - `objectql-slot-consumer-census` counts `objectQLProvider` (14 in `rest-server.ts` at both; 0 in the moved body);
     - `auth-gate-allowlist-fault-window` and `execctx-authz-input-seam-reachability` read other regions, and `liveness/key-mention.test.ts` uses the file name only in a synthetic fixture;
     - `rest-server-closed-query-params.test.ts` imports `GLOBAL_SEARCH_PARAMS` by name, and the binding did not move.
   - **Gates that walk `packages/rest/src` still reach the moved code in its new file.** These are `check-rest-log-declared`, `check-durability-degradation-log-level`, `check-meta-type-normalized`, `check-dispatcher-error-vocabulary` and `check-error-status-conformance`.
   - **Stale prose, two items, none of them read by a gate** (③ items 9 and 10).

### ② Semver level

- **`skip-changeset` is right.** Nothing a released package publishes changes.
  - **`@objectstack/rest`:**
    - The `.d.ts` and the export list hold by construction (① item 4).
    - The routes and their registration order hold by the move (① item 1).
  - **The rest of the diff:**
    - tests, including `@objectstack/dogfood`'s (a `private` package);
    - the test-side registrar list, which `src/index.ts` does not reach;
    - comments;
    - one gate's target table.
  - **The one runtime difference is the handler's `this`.** It is now the host literal, not the server. The body reaches the server only through the four forwarded members, and each forwards to the server. A stack trace gains one forwarder frame, which the execctx census expects by design. No shipped wiring can observe it.
  - A move that changes no behaviour is not a feature or a fix. So no `patch` changeset is owed, the same reading slices 1–8 landed on.
- **`Clause-②: no` is right.**
  - The door reads `req.params.environmentId` and `req.query`, as before, and refuses the same closed set.
  - No route is added or removed, and no `spec` key moves.
  - No accept set widens or narrows, so no `(narrowing)` arm is owed.
  - Line 2 of the PR body carries the line. No changeset exists to carry it a second time.
- **The changeset check's history:**
  - `Check Changeset` concluded failure at 14:12:56Z, before the label.
  - `skip-changeset` was written at 14:18:00Z by `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, the seat's write path.
  - The re-run concluded `skipped` at 14:18:03Z.

### ③ Boundary flags

Every dev flag is answered or escalated. The flags come from two places: the PR body's Acceptance notes, and the report's (`6217434161`) `deviations` and `out_of_scope_findings`. The report's `open_questions` is empty.

1. **Acceptance note: `objectql-slot-consumer-census.test.ts` is not touched.** Answered: right. The moved body reads no provider slot, and the census's tokens did not move (① item 7).
2. **Acceptance note: the moved `[#7606]` comment still reads true.** Verified. It names `query-allowlist.ts`, not a file for the export route. The export route keeps the same order, recognition then arity (`data-action-routes.ts` `:841`–`:842`).
3. **Deviation: the container restart during `pr_create`.** Answered: not a contract matter. The PR object agrees with the read-back: draft, base `main`, head `06bd4fcbc9`, assignee `os-tesla`.
4. **Deviation: the move landed as two commits.** Answered: right. This record judges the net diff. The final header names none of the three closures in prose (0 hits in `:1`–`:41`), so no census reads the header as a seam.
5. **Deviation: an eighth route configuration, `enableSearch: false`.** Answered: the dev's evidence, not re-run. It covers the door's own switch.
6. **Deviation: a late-binding measurement stands in for a getter ablation.** Answered: right. No getter exists (① item 3), so there is no by-value case to ablate.
7. **Deviation: `GLOBAL_SEARCH_PARAMS` stays in `rest-server.ts` with no use there.** Answered: right. The claim orders helpers exported from where they are declared, never copied. Its readers are the module and `rest-server-closed-query-params.test.ts`. Its docblock names the search handler, not a file, so it stays true.
8. **Deviation: `origin/main` moved on after the one merge, and `check:pnpm-flag-spellings` was not measured locally.** Answered: not blocking. CI runs on the merge ref with base `7277c07f6`, and `Lint & Repo Gates` concluded success there.
9. **Out-of-scope finding 1: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` `:8304`.** Answered: note only, 承接者:无.
   - It says `registerSearchEndpoints` (in `rest-server.ts`) 501s when `protocol.searchAll` is not a function.
   - The method of that name still lives in `rest-server.ts` and still registers the door. Its stub points to `search-routes.ts`, where the 501 now sits (`:86`).
   - The behaviour it states is unchanged. It is another lane's comment, and nothing reads it.
10. **Out-of-scope finding 2: the `UNDECLARED_WHOLE_NUMBER_PARAM` docblock** (head `:755`–`:768`). **ESCALATED to the seat, non-blocking.**
